name: Inventory reconciliation
explanation: Adds read-only technical-inventory entries to reconciliation: definition evidence debt against the base, code changes, non-current Item pins, selection health and unreferenced definitions that need the user's choice.

code.note: Classifies each stale definition reference against the base inventory and asks the user about unreferenced definitions unless explicitly proposed or new.
Routes Items whose documentation pin is stale, retired, missing or conflicted to their slide for reassessment.
Routes selections that no longer resolve, drifted inside the subset or changed outside it to their Item, never to evidence-file commands.
Joins the inventory summary and entries to the reconciliation report using the same resolver and base inventory.
